messages:
maya_cs: Kicking off HarborView week0 onboarding thread. Top items: KMS key approval (ticket CS-7021) still waiting on approved key policy, partner egress to 34.89.200.0/24 blocked, and audit events not showing up in their Loki endpoint. Can infra/security own next steps?

aditya_se: Saw the ticket. Security asked for least-privilege key policy that prevents Sign/Verify for user-facing keys and allows only Encrypt/Decrypt for service principals. I'll sketch a policy and ping @tess_security.

linus_infra: For egress we need exact destination CIDR+ports and justification. I can queue the firewall change but need an owner for change request. @maya_cs please confirm.

maya_cs: Confirming partner CIDR 34.89.200.0/24 ports 443 and 9000 (9000 used for metrics ingestion). Justification: partner API + metrics collector. Also HarborView asked about KMS key rotation cadence and whether automatic rotation is enabled.

tess_security: Prefer rotation every 90 days by default, auto-rotate can be enabled if customer ok. For this customer they requested manual rotation for now; that's acceptable but note in policy. Also need key alias and ARN in the policy request.

raj_ops: On audit forwarding - they gave Loki URL: https://loki.harborview.io/loki/api/v1/push and token. Common failures: TLS hostname verification issues if CA chain missing, or bearer token not set on forwarder. Quick test curl to validate connectivity: 

```
curl -v -X POST "https://loki.harborview.io/loki/api/v1/push" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"streams":[{"stream":{"job":"redwood-test"},"values":[["$(date +%s%N)","test event"]]}]}'
```

If that fails please paste error. Also check VPC Flow Logs to their S3 path s3://hv-logs-redwood/flow/ for recent files.

deploybot: priv-deploy/harborview v0.9.1 smoke-run at 1789999975. results: firewall:pending, kms:policy-pending, audit-forward:failed

linus_infra: I've pre-authorized the change request. Applied rule cr-452 to allow 34.89.200.0/24:443,9000 egress from subnets private-a,b. Will be active in ~3m.

maya_cs: Sent the KMS details back to the customer (alias: alias/harborview-prod, requested ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01). Also captured manual rotation preference. Pushed update to CS ticket CS-7021.

tess_security: I posted a minimal key policy draft in the ticket that restricts usage to the redwood-infra service principal and prohibits iam:PassRole/decrypt by end users. Tagging @aditya_se for review.

aditya_se: I'll convert the policy to a CFN snippet for them and include inline instructions for cross-account role. Recommend they create role in their account with trust to arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/redwood-logger. Will post snippet by EOD.

raj_ops: After firewall is live I'll rerun the Loki curl and test forwarder. Will attach logs.

maya_cs: Customer flagged timeline sensitivity: told AM that if audit ingestion is not confirmed within 5 business days this becomes high-touch renewal conversation. Marking renewal-risk if not resolved in 5 days. Adding to renewal board and tagging finance.

linus_infra: Firewall shows active. please retry.

raj_ops: Reran curl at 1789999996. Response: HTTP/1.1 204 No Content — successful. Forwarder logs show auth header present. Uploading forwarder log snippet to CS-7021.

deploybot: Reminder scheduled follow-up 1790086400 (week1 check). reaction :eyes:

maya_cs: Action list: @aditya_se finalize CFN iam role snippet; @tess_security approve key policy and close CS-7021; @raj_ops confirm sustained log delivery for 24h and drop artifacts in ticket; @linus_infra confirm firewall persisted and note change request id cr-452. Will review tomorrow AM with AM and finance. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
